_meta.method: Colours sampled 2026-09-24 with Pillow from official manufacturer product/press images (point medians on lit faces + hue-filtered dominant-colour medians). Photos carry lighting/grading bias; hexes are 'drawing' values chosen from well-lit faces, not paint-code specs.
_meta.extraFields: chassisLight = light grey/silver frame, deck or fender panels where the brand uses them.

Liebherr.notes: LTM 1070-4.2 outdoor photos, warm-graded. Sunlit yellow measured #db8701 to #e79d06, shade #ac6705. That's a deep golden yellow, more orange than Grove or Kato; #e8a00a is the lit value. Carrier cab and deck yellow. Frame side and fender panels light silver-grey (chassisLight), lower frame and bumpers near-black. Counterweight top slab is yellow with embossed LIEBHERR, base plates dark grey #6b7070. Rims grey #a7b2b2. Red/white chevrons on boom head and carrier ends.

Liebherr crawler.notes: LR crawler photo. Lattice boom, carbody, crawler side frames and even the track pads are Liebherr yellow (shade #be7805, lit #cb9314). Counterweight slabs are light blue-grey with embossed LIEBHERR, a real difference from the LTM. Caution: the superstructure in this photo is a customer's blue (Sarens); the factory standard superstructure is yellow like the LTM, which I'm going on from brand knowledge, not this photo.

Manitowoc Grove.notes: GMK3060-2 official studio cut-out. Bright lemon/golden yellow: dominant median #eab719, highlights #fecf39. Carrier cab and carrier body yellow. Chassis frame dark grey #3b3b42, decking and step plates aluminium grey. Wheel rims painted yellow (#edbf1c). Counterweight block dark grey. Outrigger beams grey/black.

Manitowoc Grove GRT.notes: GRT9165 official side-view render. Differs from the GMK: carrier chassis and deck are mid/light grey, not yellow, and the counterweight is yellow. Rims yellow (#d6ac24), tyres near-black. Dark 'GROVE' lettering on the boom and 'GRT' in red on the superstructure side.

Manitowoc crawler.notes: Manitowoc red over everything above the tracks: lattice boom, mast, superstructure, counterweight stack. MLC165 cut-out is dark (#8c1f1f); the MLC300 daylight photo gives lit #ab1227 to #c01028. Crawler frames and track pads black. Operator cab grey. White 'Manitowoc' logo on the boom butt and superstructure.

Tadano.notes: Current Tadano corporate livery on AC, ATF and GR models alike: white boom, superstructure, operator cab and carrier driver cab. Carrier frame, fenders, outrigger boxes, wheel rims and counterweight are Tadano navy blue (median #012e78). Blue TADANO logo on the boom. Red/white warning bands on the boom head and bumpers. Older Tadano/Demag-era machines used other schemes; this is the current factory standard.

Kato.notes: SL-250Rv official studio photo (Kato site banners confirm the same scheme across the SR/SL/CR range). Saturated golden yellow: dominant median #f8bd00, highlights #fec401. Carrier body and chassis are charcoal/black, with a yellow front bumper and lamp bar. Boom head sheaves and jib/boom-head fittings are deep red (#8c1f18 in shade, about #a8222a lit). KATO logo in white on a dark plate on the boom. Rims grey.

Kobelco.notes: CKE G-4 series official renders. Kobelco turquoise/teal (median #45a5a7, lit #5cc7c8) on the lattice boom, mast, superstructure housing and counterweight. Dark grey band along the lower superstructure and cab surround (stripe). Carbody, crawler frames and track pads black. White KOBELCO logo on the boom.

Sumitomo / Hitachi Sumitomo.notes: SCX1200-3 official image (current -3 series, Sumitomo Heavy Industries Construction Cranes / HSC). Black lattice boom and mast. Superstructure housing and cab light grey/white. Counterweight bright sky-blue (#037edf to #099ae6). Dark blue stripe on the superstructure side. Blue 'HSC CRANES' lettering on the boom. Carbody and tracks black. See the -2 legacy key for the older blue-body scheme.

Sumitomo / Hitachi Sumitomo (SCX-2 legac.notes: SCX800-2 official image. Older generation: mid-blue superstructure, mast and counterweight, white cab, black lattice boom, black tracks.

XCMG.notes: XCA60_S (all-terrain) and XCT60_Y1 (truck) official cut-outs from xcmgglobal.com. Standard 'XCMG yellow' is a deep orange-yellow: render median #f3a600, highlights #ffc100; the XCT60 photo reads #d18c25. Boom, superstructure, operator cab, carrier cab and counterweight are all yellow. Frame, bumpers and outrigger boxes dark grey/black. Silver rims. The stripe value is the dark-grey XCMG boom lettering; boom-head sheaves are red. QY-series trucks share this scheme.

XCMG crawler.notes: XGC100A and XGC320 official renders. Lighter, lemon-leaning yellow than the wheeled range (median #d3a430, lit #f4c039). Counterweight dark grey/black with yellow warning triangles. Cab dark grey. Carbody and tracks black. Blue XCMG logo on the boom (stripe). Red sheaves at the boom and mast heads.

XCMG white (North America _U models).notes: XCMG North America sells XCA_U/XCT_U models in a white livery: white boom, superstructure and cabs, black frame and outriggers, navy XCMG logo and chevrons (median #1c3679), red/white stripes along the deck edge. White reads #c4cad0 in shade in these photos; #eceeef is the lit value. Use only for US-market models.

Sany.notes: STC250C5 official cut-out. Two-colour scheme: SANY red telescopic boom (median #ca1a23, lit #d81b25) over an orange-yellow carrier cab, superstructure and operator cab (median #df8e04, lit #e69500). Frame, bumper and lower carrier dark grey/black. White SANY and model lettering on the red boom. Red/white stripe along the deck edge.

Sany crawler.notes: SCC1800A official render. Red lattice boom and mast (median #c42e2d, lit #e14443). Yellow superstructure housing. The counterweight stack is dark charcoal, not yellow, which is the main difference from the trucks. Carbody and tracks black. Cab housing yellow with large dark glazing.

Zoomlion.notes: ZTC250V5-2 official cut-out. Current Zoomlion livery: lime/yellow-green telescopic boom top and sides (median #99d400, lit #a3e003) with a dark charcoal lower boom band (stripe). Silver-grey carrier cab, superstructure and operator cab, with dark angular graphic panels. Black chassis frame.

Zoomlion crawler.notes: ZCC product-list images (low-res). Green lattice boom and mast (#6e9931 to #85cc4d across the two photos; #7fc03a picked between them). Superstructure housing and counterweight dark charcoal/grey, not silver like the trucks. Tracks black. Low-resolution sources, so treat the green as approximate; the truck value #99d40a is the cleaner reading of the same brand green.
